help_description: Measure what Home Assistant Assist sends to your LLM, trim it to fit the context window, and undo it safely.
help_epilog: Start with: assist-budget demo   (a practice run with a sample house, no Home Assistant needed)
help_lang: Output language: en or ko. Default: the {env} environment variable, then LC_ALL / LC_MESSAGES / LANG, else en.
help_report: Rebuild the Assist prompt from a Home Assistant config folder and count its tokens.
help_suggest: Write a plan file that hides the most expensive, least useful entities until the prompt fits.
help_apply: Apply a plan file to a running Home Assistant (dry-run unless --yes).
help_undo: Restore the exposure saved in an undo file (dry-run unless --yes).
help_demo: Practice run: sample house, fake in-process Home Assistant, no token or network needed.
help_path: Home Assistant config folder (the one that contains .storage) or the .storage folder itself. Files are only read.
help_ha_version: Home Assistant version, for example 2026.11.3. Needed only when the folder has no .HA_VERSION file.
help_ctx: Model context window in tokens (Ollama num_ctx). Default: 8192.
help_reserve: Tokens to set aside for tools and chat history, which this tool does not count. Default: 0.
help_margin: Safety margin in percent: the prompt is 'tight' inside this margin. Default: 10.
help_tokenizer: Token counter: approx (characters / 4, no dependencies) or tekken (needs: pip install 'assist-budget[tekken]').
help_instructions: Text file with your own conversation-agent instructions, to count instead of the default ones.
help_top: How many entities to list in the top table. Default: 10.
help_format: Output format: table, json or md.
help_fail_over: Exit with code 1 when the verdict is 'over' (for scripts and CI).
help_target: Token goal for the system prompt. Default: derived from --ctx, --margin and --reserve.
help_keep: Never hide entities matching this glob, for example 'light.*'. Can be repeated.
help_drop: Always hide entities matching this glob. Can be repeated.
help_out: Write the plan to this file. Without it the plan YAML is printed.
help_token_env: Name of the environment variable that holds a long-lived access token. Default: HA_TOKEN.
help_apply_yes: Really change Home Assistant. Without this flag nothing is written.
help_undo_yes: Really restore the saved exposure. Without this flag nothing is written.
help_force: Apply even if exposure changed since the plan was made.
help_undo_dir: Folder for the undo file. Default: the current folder.
warn_not_counted: Tool definitions, chat history and tool results are not counted; use --reserve for them. Offline results are an upper estimate: entities that Home Assistant has not loaded are still counted.
warn_unverified_profile: Home Assistant {version}: unverified profile '{profile}'. Prompt texts come from the released source, not from output checked against a real Home Assistant, so the numbers may be a little off.
warn_newer_version: Home Assistant {version} is newer than the versions this tool knows. Using the closest profile '{profile}'; check the numbers against the Assist debug view.
warn_registry_version: {name} has format version {seen}, newer than the verified {known}. Results may be incomplete.
warn_no_restore_state: No core.restore_state file: entities that exist only as states (not in the registry) cannot be named and are left out.
warn_entity_skipped_no_name: {entity_id} is exposed but not in the registry and has no saved state, so it has no name and is left out.
suggest_summary: Plan: hide {count} entities. System prompt {before} -> {after} tokens (goal {target}, tokenizer {tokenizer}).
suggest_target_missed: The goal of {target} tokens cannot be reached with the safe rules alone. Use --drop 'domain.*' to hide more, or raise --ctx.
suggest_written: Plan written to {path}. Review it, then run: assist-budget apply {path} --url ws://HOST:8123/api/websocket
apply_version_differs: Note: the plan was made for Home Assistant {plan}, the server runs {live}.
apply_header_dry: DRY RUN: {count} changes would be sent to Home Assistant {version}.
apply_header_yes: APPLY: sending {count} changes to Home Assistant {version}.
apply_estimate: Expected system prompt: {before} -> {after} tokens ({saved} fewer, tokenizer {tokenizer}).
apply_conflict: Stopped, nothing was sent: {count} entities no longer match the plan (for example {sample}). Make a new plan with 'suggest', or add --force to apply anyway.
apply_conflict_forced: Warning: {count} entities differ from the plan; continuing because of --force.
apply_dry_run_done: Nothing was sent to Home Assistant. Add --yes to apply.
apply_done: Applied {count} changes and checked them in Home Assistant. To go back: assist-budget undo {path} --url ... --yes
apply_verify_failed: Home Assistant did not confirm {count} changes (for example {sample}). Restore with: assist-budget undo {path} --url ... --yes
undo_header_dry: DRY RUN: {count} of {total} entities would be restored.
undo_done: Restored {count} entities and checked them in Home Assistant.
undo_verify_failed: Home Assistant did not confirm {count} entities (for example {sample}). Check the Voice assistants page.
demo_banner: MOCK practice run - fake in-process Home Assistant server; token numbers are a real reconstruction of the bundled sample house
demo_step_report: [1/5] Measure the sample house against a {ctx}-token window
demo_report_line: {exposed} exposed entities, system prompt {tokens} tokens = {pct}% of the window -> {verdict}
demo_step_plan: [2/5] Plan: hide the costliest unneeded entities until the prompt fits {target} tokens
demo_nothing_to_trim: Nothing to trim at this window size. Try a smaller one: assist-budget demo --ctx 4096
demo_step_dry: [3/5] Dry run against the fake Home Assistant
demo_writes_received: write commands the fake server received: {count}
demo_after_line: after trimming: system prompt {tokens} tokens = {pct}% of the window -> {verdict}
demo_step_undo: [5/5] Undo with the saved undo file
demo_restored: restored: the fake Home Assistant exposes exactly the same {count} entities as at the start
demo_not_restored: NOT restored: exposure differs from the start (this is a bug, please report it)
demo_next: Next: assist-budget report <your HA config folder> --ctx 8192
err_no_storage: {path} has no .storage folder. Pass the Home Assistant config folder (it contains .storage and configuration.yaml), or the .storage folder itself.
err_no_entity_registry: {path} has no core.entity_registry file. This does not look like a Home Assistant .storage folder.
err_bad_storage_file: Cannot parse {path}: {reason}. Copy a fresh .storage folder from your Home Assistant.
err_no_version: Cannot tell the Home Assistant version: {path} has no .HA_VERSION file. Add --ha-version, for example --ha-version 2026.11.3.
err_bad_version: '{version}' is not a Home Assistant version like 2026.11.3.
err_unsupported_version: Home Assistant {version} is older than 2025.5, whose Assist prompt format this tool does not support yet (before 2025.5 the prompt also carried entity states).
err_tekken_missing: The tekken tokenizer needs an optional package. Install it with: pip install 'assist-budget[tekken]'
err_tekken_data: Cannot load the tekken tokenizer data at {path}: {reason}. Reinstall with: pip install --force-reinstall 'assist-budget[tekken]'
err_wrong_schema: {path} is not an assist-budget file of type {expected}. Use the file written by 'suggest' (plan) or 'apply --yes' (undo).
err_bad_change: {path}: change number {index} is invalid ({reason}). Fix or delete that entry.
err_bad_url: '{url}' is not a WebSocket URL. Use ws://HOST:8123/api/websocket (or wss:// behind TLS).
err_no_token: Environment variable {name} is empty. Create a long-lived access token in your Home Assistant profile and run: export {name}=...
err_connect: Cannot connect to Home Assistant at {url}: {reason}. Check the address, that Home Assistant is running, and the port.
err_ws_protocol: {url} did not answer like Home Assistant. The URL should end in /api/websocket.
err_ws_closed: The connection to Home Assistant is closed.
err_auth: Home Assistant at {url} rejected the access token. Create a new long-lived token (admin user) and try again.
err_ha_command: Home Assistant refused '{command}' ({code}): {reason}. The token user must be an administrator.
err_write_version: Home Assistant {version} is outside {low} - {high}, the range where the expose commands were checked, so nothing was sent. Use the Voice assistants page in the Home Assistant UI instead.
err_arg_margin_range: must be from 0 up to (not including) 100
